The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.76 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.22 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted NaO₅F pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with three SO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent FeO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 46°. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.20 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. Both Fe-F bond lengths are 2.04 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form FeO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅F pentagonal pyramids, corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅F pentagonal pyramids. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å.
